# gohard.yaml

<!-- Generated by tools/genconfig from internal/config; do not edit. -->

GoHard reads its configuration from `gohard.yaml` at the
project root (#28). The project root is the nearest ancestor directory,
starting from the current directory (CLI) or the workspace folder
(language server), that contains `gohard.yaml`; if none does, the
nearest ancestor containing `.git`; if none does, the current
directory or workspace folder itself. A missing `gohard.yaml`
means every key takes its default, with no diagnostic.

Every problem is reported with the line and column of the offending key
or value. `gohard config check` prints them; every other command
that loads an invalid configuration exits 2.

* Unknown keys and duplicate keys, at any nesting level, are errors.
  Keys of `libraries`, `defines` and `simulation.models` are VHDL
  names and compare case-insensitively.
* Bool keys accept only `true` and `false`. Other YAML 1.1
  spellings (`yes`, `no`, `on`, `off`, `y`, `n`, `True`, `FALSE`
  and the like) are errors.
* An unquoted YAML 1.1 boolean spelling in a string value, such as
  `FOO: yes` under `defines`, is an error; quote it.
  Any other unquoted scalar there (`WIDTH: 8`, `X: 1.50`) is
  taken as its exact text (`"8"`, `"1.50"`); the schema
  allows numbers in those places for that reason.
* `standard` must be a quoted string: `standard: "2008"`.
* A key set to its default value gets the warning
  `config/redundant-default` (exit 1 only with `--strict`).
* `--define NAME=VALUE` overrides the `defines:` entry with
  the same name, and logs the override to stderr.
* `gohard.yaml` wins over editor settings; the language server
  reports each overridden editor setting in a `window/logMessage`.
* The JSON Schema is `schema/gohard.schema.json`, also printed by
  `gohard config schema`.

### `standard`

The VHDL standard files are analyzed under. It must be a quoted string: `standard: "2008"`.

* Type: "1993"|"2002"|"2008"|"2019"
* Default: `"2008"`

### `lenient`

Relax analysis rules that other VHDL tools commonly relax. Under `lenient: true`: from VHDL-2002 on a shared variable need not be of a protected type, reported as a `sema/relaxed` warning (GHDL `-frelaxed`, NVC `--relaxed`); a subprogram body may add or omit `constant` on a parameter that names no mode (GHDL `-frelaxed`, NVC `--relaxed`); a subelement of a formal associated individually may be associated with `open` (GHDL `-frelaxed`, NVC `--relaxed`); a pure function may declare a file (GHDL `-frelaxed`, NVC `--relaxed`) and name an external signal or variable (GHDL `-frelaxed`); an `others` aggregate assigned to an unconstrained port, parameter or alias takes the target's index range (GHDL `-frelaxed`, NVC `--relaxed`); a name used in its own declaration denotes the outer homograph (NVC `--relaxed`; GHDL accepts it with a `-Whide` warning in every mode); an alias of a subprogram or enumeration literal may omit the signature and denotes the first visible one (NVC in every mode; GHDL always requires the signature); a component instantiation may name an entity without the reserved word `entity` (neither GHDL nor NVC accepts this). Only the shared variable rule is reported; the others are accepted silently.

* Type: bool
* Default: `false`

### `psl.comments`

Parse `-- psl` comment lines as PSL.

* Type: bool
* Default: `false`

### `psl.strict_keywords`

Report PSL-only words used as identifiers as errors (GHDL-style).

* Type: bool
* Default: `false`

### `libraries`

Maps each library name to the folders holding its sources, relative to the project root. Files in no listed folder go to `work`. A missing or unreadable folder is a setup error (exit 2).

* Type: map: library name to list of folders
* Default: `{}`

### `allow_opaque`

Encrypted units that may stay opaque. It downgrades encrypted IP only; unsupported constructs stay exit 2. `gohard libs detect --write` fills it in.

* Type: list of `lib.unit`
* Default: `[]`

### `defines`

User conditional-analysis identifiers. `--define NAME=VALUE` overrides an entry with the same name. Defining a built-in identifier (`VHDL_VERSION`, `TOOL_TYPE`, `TOOL_VENDOR`, `TOOL_NAME`, `TOOL_EDITION`, `TOOL_VERSION`) is a setup error (exit 2).

* Type: map: identifier to string
* Default: `{}`

### `format.indent`

Spaces per indentation level.

* Type: int >= 1
* Default: `2`

### `format.keyword_case`

Case of reserved words.

* Type: lower|upper|preserve
* Default: `lower`

### `format.align_ports`

Align port, generic and association lists.

* Type: bool
* Default: `true`

### `format.max_line_length`

Lines longer than this are wrapped.

* Type: int >= 40
* Default: `80`

### `lint.clock_edge_style`

A clk'event edge test in a design that also uses rising_edge or falling_edge (`lint/clock-edge-style`).

* Type: off|hint|warning
* Default: `off`

### `lint.latch`

A combinational process does not assign a signal on every path, so it infers a latch (`lint/latch`).

* Type: off|hint|warning
* Default: `warning`

### `lint.sensitivity_list`

A combinational process reads a signal its sensitivity list does not name (`lint/sensitivity-list`).

* Type: off|hint|warning
* Default: `warning`

### `lint.unused_signal`

A signal never read or never assigned, an in port never read, an out port never assigned (`lint/unused-signal`).

* Type: off|hint|warning
* Default: `warning`

### `simulation.auto_run_on_save`

When on, testbench candidates whose dependencies changed run after a short debounce on save. The code lens and the CLI always run.

* Type: bool
* Default: `false`

### `simulation.testbenches`

Entities to treat as testbenches, in addition to every entity without ports.

* Type: list of entity names
* Default: `[]`

### `simulation.seed`

The simulation seed: it fixes the in-delta process order. 0 keeps declaration order.

* Type: uint64
* Default: `0`

### `simulation.time_budget`

Simulated time after which a run stops with `sim/budget-exceeded`.

* Type: VHDL time string
* Default: `"1 ms"`

### `simulation.delta_budget`

Delta cycles allowed per time step.

* Type: int >= 1
* Default: `10000`

### `simulation.step_budget`

Kernel steps allowed per run.

* Type: int >= 1
* Default: `50000000`

### `simulation.stop_level`

The assertion severity that stops a run. It does not change severities or exit codes.

* Type: note|warning|error|failure
* Default: `error`

### `simulation.dump_scope`

Only signals under these instance paths are traced. Empty traces every signal. Traces always go to `.gohard/traces/`.

* Type: list of instance-path prefixes
* Default: `[]`

### `simulation.models`

Maps an opaque unit to the user's own plain VHDL model. GoHard checks that the stand-in's ports match the real component's.

* Type: map: `lib.unit` to stand-in file path
* Default: `{}`

### `simulation.env.epoch`

The wall-clock time of simulated time 0: `EPOCH`, `GMTIME` and `LOCALTIME` report it plus the simulated time, in UTC, unless `--real-env` is given (in effect since v1.1).

* Type: RFC 3339 UTC time
* Default: `"2000-01-01T00:00:00Z"`

### `simulation.env.vars`

The only variables `GETENV` sees (in effect since v1.1); `--env NAME=VALUE` overrides an entry. `--real-env` reads the real environment instead.

* Type: map: name to string
* Default: `{}`
